selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: Who is described as creating both the universe and life?
questions.answer: Allah, the All-Powerful and Wise One.

questions.question: What did Allah make life to be in relation to the universe?
questions.answer: He made it a compact reflection of the whole universe.

questions.question: What inner quality helps living things seek provision?
questions.answer: A desire or appetite for it.

questions.question: Which part of creation is linked with angels and spirit beings?
questions.answer: The heavens are linked with them.

questions.question: What does the image of beings being “driven” toward provision suggest?
questions.answer: It suggests that need strongly pushes them into motion and action.

questions.question: What comparison is made between animals and trees?
questions.answer: Animals must seek their food, but trees receive theirs without effort.

questions.question: What would such an eye notice about Allah’s Names?
questions.answer: It would see the beauty of Allah’s mercy and His providing for creation.

questions.question: What beauty would that broad sight discover?
questions.answer: It would discover the gentleness and care in Allah’s feeding of creatures.

questions.question: What does the phrase about an unseen treasury point to?
questions.answer: It points to Allah as the hidden and true source of all provision.

questions.question: What main message about tawhid can be understood from this passage?
questions.answer: The ordered feeding of creation points to one Lord who controls and provides for all.

questions.question: What two creations are connected at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The universe and life are connected as creations of Allah.

questions.question: What did Allah place within living things regarding provision?
questions.answer: He placed a desire and need for sustenance in them.

questions.question: What broad effect of divine care is described in the realms of creation?
questions.answer: Different realms are filled with fitting beings and made joyful.

questions.question: Which part is linked especially with birds and other living things?
questions.answer: The physical world, especially the air and earth.

questions.question: If animals received food without effort like trees, what would be missing?
questions.answer: A wise system that moves them to action and fulfills larger purposes would be missing.

questions.question: What would a person with a complete view of the earth be able to witness?
questions.answer: The beautiful way Allah mercifully feeds creatures across the earth.

questions.question: How are the new foods for animals described?
questions.answer: They are described as tasty, plentiful, and varied.

questions.question: What final understanding would such an observer reach?
questions.answer: That Allah alone sends help and sustenance to creation with perfect mercy and wisdom.

questions.question: What title-like qualities of Allah are emphasized in this passage?
questions.answer: His power, wisdom, mercy, and providing.

questions.question: What role does provision play within the world of living things?
questions.answer: It is shown as a central activity around which much of life moves.

questions.question: What is one important purpose of creating the desire for provision?
questions.answer: It helps living beings respond to Allah’s care and love through thankful worship.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest is one major wisdom in the universe?
questions.answer: One major wisdom is that seeking provision trains creatures in action, gratitude, and service.

questions.question: What special kind of eye does the passage imagine?
questions.answer: An eye able to see and understand the whole earth at once.

questions.question: What kind of sight is imagined in the last paragraph of the target passage?
questions.answer: A sight broad enough to observe the whole earth together.
